mainSwitch.@Tooltip: Controls the rendering of all widgets.

renderCorner.@Tooltip: Specifies in which corner of the screen the widgets will be rendered.

margin.@Tooltip: Specifies the margin from the edges of the screen.

spacing.@Tooltip: Specifies the spacing between each widget.

wrap.@Tooltip:
Specifies the amount of widgets allowed on a single line before wrapping to a new one.
Setting the value to zero or lower disables this feature.

wrapSpacing.@Tooltip: Specifies the amount of spacing between each wrapped line.

updateTime.@Tooltip: Specifies the amount of time (in seconds) between each ping update.

greenPingRange.@Tooltip:
Specifies the range of ping values for the green color.

Follows the formula:
From [1] to [Value]

yellowPingRange.@Tooltip:
Specifies the range of ping values for the yellow color.

Follows the formula, where X is the sum of all previous values:
From [X + 1] to [X + Value]

orangePingRange.@Tooltip:
Specifies the range of ping values for the orange color.

Follows the formula, where X is the sum of all previous values:
From [X + 1] to [X + Value]

All ping values after this range will result in the red ping color.
